literal: In the mind, being one who is without impurity, that much is virtue; of the nature of empty show are other things.
translation: To be spotless in mind is the entirety of virtue; all else is merely empty, ostentatious show.
modern: மனதில் குற்றம் இல்லாதவனாக இருப்பதே அறம் ஆகும்; மற்றவை எல்லாம் வெறும் ஆரவாரத் தன்மை உடையவை.
explanation: This couplet defines the true essence of virtue as internal purity. The poet states that being free from mental impurities (மாசு இலன் ஆதல்) is the complete measure of virtue (அனைத்து அறன்). Any external action or ritual performed without this inner purity is dismissed as mere ostentation or empty noise (ஆகுல நீர பிற). The word 'மனத்துக்கண்' emphasizes that the locus of virtue is the mind, and 'ஆகுல' highlights the loud, showy nature of superficial deeds.
